episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Yu Takasaki and Ayumu Uehara are wandering around Odaiba when they see a school idol named Setsuna Yuki performing and are totally moved. They find out that she actually goes to their school, and they go check out the School Idol Club she belongs to.

tmdb.synopsis: Yu Takasaki and Ayumu Uehara are wandering around Odaiba when they see a school idol named Setsuna Yuki performing and are totally moved. They find out that she actually goes to their school, and they go check out the School Idol Club she belongs to.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Kasumi refuses to accept the fact that the School Idol Club has been disbanded and decides to take matters into her own hands. Meanwhile, Karin tries to track down the elusive Setsuna Yuki.

episodes.synopsis: The former members of the School Idol Club confront the student council president about her true identity. Meanwhile, Yu gushes about Setsuna Yuki to Nana, and Nana sheds some light on why Setsuna might've quit being a school idol.
